display_long_description:
Tendy — 3D Camera, Cast & Viewer for Meta Quest

Turn your Meta Quest 3/3S from a viewing device into a 3D camera, phone display, and immersive content hub.

Tendy brings capture, casting, and 3D viewing into one unified experience.

📷 3D Camera (Quest 3/3S)

Capture stereoscopic content using Passthrough cameras.

SBS 3D photos & videos
Real-time stereoscopic preview
Auto-save to device storage
📱 Phone Cast

Bring your phone into VR.

Supports Android & iPhone
Watch videos, apps, games, and camera feeds
Low-latency real-time display
▶️ YouTube SBS 3D

Watch YouTube 3D content directly in Quest.

Supports side-by-side (SBS) format
No download or conversion required
Instant immersive playback
🆓 Free Trial

Try core features for free:

SBS 3D photos — unlimited
SBS 3D videos — 10 sec per clip
Phone Cast — 3 min per session
YouTube SBS — up to 720p
No ads
⭐ Tendy Pro

Unlock the full 3D experience:

Unlimited recording time
Unlimited Phone Cast
High-quality YouTube playback
YouTube 3D conversion
One-time purchase (no subscription)

Users with SpatialCam Pro can also unlock Pro features.

🌐 3D / VR Content Discovery

Find curated 3D and VR videos optimized for Quest.

👉 Try for free first, upgrade anytime.
